newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica bond mkt turnover nears 2 trln rand in H1.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica bond mkt turnover nears 2 trln rand in H1.

text.p: Turnover on the South African bond market grew to 285.2 billion rand in June, bringing total turnover on the market to nearly two trillion rand in the first half of the year, the Bond Exchange said on Wednesday.
The exchange said turnover in the month rose to 285.15 billion rand from 298.46 billion rand in May, while cumulative turnover for the first six months of 1997 stood at 1,717 billion rand.
Total net foreign purchases in the month amounted to 2.058 billion rand, while total foreign purchases and sales amounted to 67 billion rand -- 23 percent of total turnover.
Offshore trades directly between non-residents eased to 54.96 billion rand from 62.18 billion rand in May, bringing total offshore trades to 306.89 billion rand in the year to date.
Repurchase transactions accounted for 52 percent of trade -- unchanged from May.
